items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: I think Artis Starks was on there... So we came back pain night... I knew we'd get that money.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, Dutre taught me, Roy taught me more so. And then I, later on as I progressed, I joined Eli Rice's band. I stayed with him about 14 months. We traveled all through Wisconsin and Minnesota and Michigan, Michigan and Minnesota. And I used to get out there in them woods and practice. So after 14 months I came back to Chicago and I played the great pianist Teddy Weller for him at the Dream. And Shirley Clare was on the cornet myself and Teddy and I had forgotten the fellow who could play drum and sing very…
I think Audis Starks was on there, Clamondon and Saxe.

So we came back, Pay Night and Padlock was on the place. I know 5250 was paying us. I didn't really get that money, I just said married to. And so then I went and joined Arthur Sims in Milwaukee at the Wisconsin Roof. And so after about a year with Arthur, Arthur caught pneumonia in August and died. So then a fellow who is now a physician, Arthur Albright, he was the oldest man in the band. He was a guitar player and banjoist. So he was taking over the band and then he left to go to Meharry to study medicine.…
